about: READ-ONLY: renders which named refs `github-delete-refs` WOULD delete from a GitHub repository, and changes nothing (infra/forge/github-act.sh delete-refs --plan; design 76155676, backlog 6a8ff89f). It lists the repository with git ls-remote, as the GitHub App's installation on <owner>, and names each requested ref (heads/<branch> or tags/<tag>, in full, comma-separated, at most 200) with the sha it stands at — the lease the write will push against — or as already absent, plus the default branch and the reason. Naming the repository's DEFAULT branch, naming heads/main or heads/master with the reason `none`, a ref git does not allow, a pattern, a duplicate, or an unusable token slot is a refusal, exit 78, not a plan. No clock and no token in the bytes; its sha256 is printed on stderr as `plan-sha256:`, and that hash is what David's passkey signs (design 17835005 q1).
